detail_text: Specifically, your firm does not exercise proper gowning technique to ensure safety and sterility of the sterile drug product. General gowning attire for entry in the IS05/IS07 classified areas consists of the following: Scrubs donned outside the facility, non-sterile lint-free lab coat, a non-sterile single hairnet, a non-sterile ear-loop face mask and dedicated shoes worn in IS05/IS07 areas. The general gowning requirements leave exposed skin around the eyes, forehead and neck of the person preparing the drug product. For example, a) On 4/23/ 15, I observed operator <Redaction b4> preparing a syringe of Vancomycin Lot #HIC042215-1SS with a tear in the front of <Redaction b4> hairnet directly above <Redaction b4> forehead in the ISO 5 area. b) On 4/24/15, a pharmacy technician <Redaction b6> from your firm was performing aseptic filling Lot # C164432/C157764 of Bupivicaine/Clonidine Injectable inside the ISO 5 laminar air-flow hood wearing scrubs donned outside the facility, non-sterile lint-free lab coat, a non-sterile single hairnet, a non-sterile ear-loop face mask, and dedicated shoes. c) On 4/24/ 15, I observed operator <Redaction b4> preparing Lot# Cl66853/C157764 of Morphine/Clonidine injectable with arms resting on the work bench area of laminar flow hood # <Redaction b4> inside the ISO 5 area wearing a non-sterile, lint-free lab coat.
